title: The explicit source bar tower
statement: Let Y be a scheme, L a cochain tower, and D the supplied stage-filtered finite-piece diagram [lem-sc-compact-flat-finite-subcomplex-diagrams]. Define R_n to be the bar total [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] of the full subdiagram with stage at most n. Its transition is reindexing along the stage inclusion, and its augmentation c_n:R_n -> L_n is the bar augmentation of the specified colimit cocone.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; The explicit source bar tower.

proof.text: Restrict D.diagram along compactFlatStageInclusion at n. The subtype inclusion at n+1 and identity component transformation induce the transition by bar reindexing. Apply totalAugmentation to the supplied cocone at n. All data is given by coproducts and functorial maps.
